criteria.justification: V3__create_preference_profiles.sql, an already-applied migration, is directly edited to add a display_nickname column — this is the textbook 'edit an applied migration' violation the rule exists to prevent, and Neon's free tier cannot roll it back. Separately, the new V6__create_profile_audit.sql uses `id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY`, which is Postgres-only DDL that will not parse the same way on H2 in the way the repo's portable idiom (`BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY`) does, breaking dual-engine portability for a brand-new file.

spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto is changed from validate to update in application.properties, exactly the change the rule calls out by name, with a comment openly stating the intent to let Hibernate mutate the schema instead of adding a migration. This defeats the fail-fast boot-time check across every profile that shares this file.

PreferenceProfileService, an existing @Service that already uses `private final` fields with an implicit @RequiredArgsConstructor, gains a new `@Autowired private ProfileAuditRepository profileAuditRepository` field. This is precisely the field-injection pattern AGENTS.md says appears nowhere in src/main/java — it should instead be a private final constructor parameter.

The diff touches migrations, a service field, an application property, and an e2e test timing statement; it introduces no request path/parameter/body identifier, no repository ownership predicate change, and no security permit-list change, so this criterion has nothing to govern here.

A fixed `page.waitForTimeout(500)` is inserted into HtmxSmokeE2eTests between a click and the subsequent assertions, directly contradicting the stated rule that the suite contains no sleeps and that waits must be assertion- or condition-based. The surrounding getByRole-style interactions and structural assertions elsewhere in the file are untouched and remain compliant.

The only test change is the inserted sleep; the pre-existing `assertThat(toggle).hasAttribute(...)` and `.hasText(...)` assertions that verify the toggle behavior remain intact and unweakened immediately afterward, so the test can still fail if the behavior regresses. No assertion was removed, softened, or made unreachable.

findings.message: V3__create_preference_profiles.sql is an already-applied migration; adding the display_nickname column here edits it in place instead of introducing a new V{n+1} migration. On Neon's free tier this cannot be corrected once applied.

`id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY` is Postgres-specific and not the portable `BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY` idiom used elsewhere in the repo; this migration is reachable by both engines during normal test/prod runs and risks failing to apply identically on H2 vs. Postgres.

spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto changed from validate to update, defeating the fail-fast boot-time schema check across all profiles that inherit this file and allowing Hibernate to silently mutate the schema going forward.

New field `@Autowired private ProfileAuditRepository profileAuditRepository` on a production @Service introduces field injection where the class already uses constructor injection via Lombok; it should be added as a private final constructor parameter instead.

Added `page.waitForTimeout(500)` is a fixed sleep, which the e2e conventions explicitly forbid; the wait for the swap to settle should be expressed as an assertion-based or `waitForFunction` condition instead.
